blocks.Base: Weeks 1–12: build up to 30 minutes of running without stopping. Every run is easy.
blocks.Build: Weeks 13–24: one easy run, one faster session and one long run a week. Goal: 10 km under 60 min.
blocks.Strength: Weeks 25–36: longer tempo runs and intervals. Goal: 10 km under 50 min.
blocks.Speed: Weeks 37–52: faster intervals at goal pace. Goal: 10 km under 45 min.
